target.visual_information: Two raised interval traces with circular boundary marks on a number line. Compare the traces attached to the marks at 1 and 4 in the left image with the traces attached to the marks at −3 and 4 in the right image.
target.left_evidence: The raised traces extending outward from the hollow marks at 1 and 4.
target.right_evidence: The two raised traces from the hollow endpoints −3 and 4, extending outward in opposite directions.
target.left_meaning: The left trace covers values below 1 and the right trace covers values above 4, leaving a gap.
target.right_meaning: The traces select x < −3 and x > 4 on opposite sides, with none of the middle values selected.
target.reason: The selected cue in each image leaves the middle interval uncovered by both traces. This gives the same local constraint rule in the two contexts.
target.reasoning_consequence: In the left image, a bounded-interval interpretation would wrongly admit 2 despite neither trace covering it. In the right image, reporting the middle as covered would admit 0 even though it lies on neither highlighted trace.
